source_variants.adjudication: The harness signatures differ from the supplied original API pack. They are compatibility stubs and do not override the copied RTEMS baseline API. These task standards follow the baseline pack; source divergence remains documented.

facts.requirement: The caller supplies GPIO pin numbers according to the fixed GPIO timing task; single-wire or trigger/echo roles and input/output directions follow the reference driver, without introducing other buses.

Use the original five-argument rtems_gpio_request_pin(uint32_t pin_number, rtems_gpio_function function, bool output_enable, bool logic_invert, void *bsp_specific) to choose digital input/output; inspect rtems_status_code success.

Use rtems_gpio_set(uint32_t pin_number) and rtems_gpio_clear(uint32_t pin_number) for high/low output, and int rtems_gpio_get_value(uint32_t pin_number) for input level (0/1; -1 invalid/unconfigured); set/clear return rtems_status_code.

The reference calls delay_us(uint32_t us) for microsecond pulse/polling intervals; retain microsecond units and submillisecond timing capability. Its function body is an empty stub, so the underlying RTEMS timing API cannot be determined from these materials.
